description: Find Nevada Revised Statutes sections BY TOPIC rather than by number: "nonresident real estate broker", "DUI penalties", "landlord security deposit". Scans section headings (leadlines) of one chapter when chapter is given (e.g. "645" is Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons), otherwise picks the chapters whose titles best match the query and scans those. Returns ranked section numbers with their headings and chapter titles; call nv_revised_statute with a result for the full text. Heading match, not full-text or semantic; a query with no hits answers found:false and says what was scanned. Keyless.

chapter.description: Optional chapter to scan, e.g. "645" or "484C". Omit to search across the chapters whose titles match.

name: nv_statute_search
title: Nv Statute Search
